title: Optimal placement changed from Private DC to Public Cloud
summary: Historical telemetry indicates 65% idle time during business hours. Shifting to cloud elasticity saves 12,000 INR/month.
audit_rationale: Utilization history triggers dynamic tiering rule based on off-peak elasticity savings.

title: Private DC usable storage nearing 85% threshold
summary: KYC document archive growth has consumed 12 TB of private SAN storage, driving local capacity past the 80% watermark.
audit_rationale: Storage capacity watermark breach triggers proactive offload recommendation to S3 infrequent access.

title: Cloud migration blocked by co-location constraint
summary: API gateway has low sensitivity, but mandatory co-location with ledger DB enforces retention in Karnataka DC.
audit_rationale: Mandatory co-location rule in group-core-banking blocks cloud evaluation.
